corrections.coincidence: At least one active detector pair must agree after geocentric delay correction within 30 ms.
corrections.injection_filtering: Cached exact linear unit-injection matched-filter response; same signal and PSD as original branch.
corrections.veto_pair_scope: Chi-square/autocorrelation veto applied to the pair establishing coincidence.
corrections.coherent_network_statistic: Not used as a decision statistic in this run; remains a required next-stage improvement.
corrections.injection_efficiency_scope: Network SNR, two-detector, pairwise timing, and data quality; vetoes not rerun for every injection.
